method.calibration: First 80% distinct dates of original training fit the inner model; remaining training dates fit one bounded confidence scale minimizing squared match-point error. Elo freezes at each respective cutoff. No holdout outcomes fit the scale.
method.formula: p_calibrated = 0.5 + scale * (p - 0.5); scale = clamp(sum((p-0.5)*(y-0.5))/sum((p-0.5)^2), 0, 1). No intercept preserves side-swap symmetry.
method.refit: Apply the frozen scale to a model refitted on all original training rows. Calibration transfer is evaluated, not assumed; also report the fully frozen inner model on test.
method.target: Match point share: win 1, draw 0.5, loss 0.
method.breakdown: Champion and familiarity use both player perspectives, with unique match counts and event-cluster intervals. Matchup is format plus lexically sorted champions, from first champion perspective; mirrors retain original outcome-independent orientation.
method.familiarity: Relative to all original training decks: exact main/material identity; new list with all card names seen; or new list with up to/over 10% copies of unseen names. Main+material, no sideboard. Does not measure nearest-family similarity.
method.uncertainty: 400 paired event-cluster bootstrap samples; intervals omitted below 20 events; sufficientSupport requires 100 appearances and 20 events. Subgroups exploratory, no multiplicity correction; no cross-event player clustering.
limitations: Previously inspected retrospective holdout, not untouched future validation.
Single temporal calibration split; refitted model may have different confidence distribution.
Current catalog and no historical ban-era reconstruction.
Published-deck selection bias and recurring players; no causal card effect.

familiarity.key: New list, up to 10% unseen copies
